male.additional_instructions: EAST-FACING RIGHT SIDE PROFILE ONLY of the same male body. Fit ONLY the approved brown leather work boots from this same-body reference onto all TEN exact input poses: standing first, eight walking frames next, middle settling pose last. Reference shows the FRONT design/material; preserve target SIDE view. Same practical ankle-height work boots, warm dark brown leather, charcoal rubber sole, stout rounded toe facing RIGHT, small muted lace marks on the upper front, restrained side seam and heel shading. No oversized shoes, pointed toes, high heels, gold/orange accents or new outfit. Full separate boot shafts needed: approved jeans will overlap their tops as another layer. Follow EACH existing near/far foot, its precise contact/lift, toe direction and occlusion, including raised far foot; cover original toes and ankles. Do NOT flatten raised feet to standing ground row, enlarge stance, change leg positions or invent gait. Preserve native 48x64 full canvas, pivot (24,58), all original head/hand/body coordinates and frame order. Stable leather detail across standing, motion and settling without flashes. No jeans, jacket, hair, tools or ground shadow. Original body will remain authoritative: only boot pixels will be extracted at their original native coordinates, all generated anatomy discarded. West will mirror this entire East composition; do not generate West.
